# Benchmark fixture provenance

- VS Code terminology candidates come from the English source strings and the Simplified Chinese language pack. The language-pack repository is MIT licensed: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-loc
- MDN is used only to select glossary headings. Expected Chinese terms are reviewed and authored for this project; no MDN definition prose is copied. MDN prose is available under CC BY-SA 2.5 or later: https://github.com/mdn/translated-content/blob/main/files/zh-cn/mdn/writing_guidelines/attrib_copyright_license/index.md
- Identifier, naming, mixed-input, and boundary cases are authored for this project under MIT.
- CodeSearchNet is intentionally not copied into this repository because it does not provide Chinese gold labels and its full dataset is disproportionate to this test suite.
